evidence.description: Representative usage: Load GCR_BA (#0xb0000000), read clock control @ +0x204, set bit (#0x1000000), write back. Pattern: mov r4,#0xb0000000; ldr r0,[r4,#0x204]; orr r0,r0,#0x1000000; str r0,[r4,#0x204]
54 direct accesses to GCR_BA identified in firmware via literal pool and scalar search
Memory map shows GCR_BA @ 0xB000_0000 - 0xB000_01FF for System and Global Control Registers

raw_note:
Migrated from docs/findings/mmio_map.md (GCR_BA section)

Original confidence: 99%
Last verified: 2025-11-03

Key registers identified:
- 0xB0000084: GPBFUN (Port B Pin Multiplexing)
- 0xB0000204: Clock/Bus/Gate Control
- 0xB0000208, 0xB0000018, 0xB0000014: Additional clock/power control
- 0xB000008C: GPIO mux register

Usage pattern: Read-modify-write for bit manipulation (set/clear control bits)
summary: Firmware extensively accesses GCR_BA @ 0xB0000000 for system and global control. 54 direct register accesses confirmed. Key registers include GPBFUN @ 0xB0000084 (Port B pin multiplexing) and clock/bus/gate control @ 0xB0000204. Registers manipulated with read-modify-write patterns for setting/clearing control bits.
title: MMIO Global Control Registers (GCR_BA @ 0xB0000000)
